ledger_rows_before.name: _bitShift
ledger_rows_before.notes: Clean-room spec 001c5070; bitShift: VP6 raw bit reader consume step; static extern C reader keeps MSVC's private EAX reader / ECX count convention (reached through the SkipVp6RawBits wrapper absent from retail); no direct caller in retail; implemented from the spec plus retail only (no VP6 source read); full 60B exact; replaces the neutral name Rva001C5070SkipBits
